_comment: What the refresh workflow researches. Every activity is checked in every country ("countries": "all"), priority countries first, then the rest alphabetically. Categories starting with 'Myth:' feed the 'Surprising laws' list on the home page.

Myth: people think it's legal: Downloading copyrighted films for personal use
Recording a phone call without telling the other person
Taking sand or shells from the beach
Running out of fuel on the motorway
Flashing headlights to warn of a speed trap
Leaving your engine running while parked
Myth: people think it's illegal: Riding a horse on public roads
Outdoors & travel: Flying a drone in a park
Swimming in a river or lake
On the road: Riding an e-scooter on the pavement
Using a radar detector in a car
Using a phone hands-free while driving
Alcohol, tobacco & drugs: Smoking in a bar or restaurant
Home, animals & property: Installing a security camera that films the street
